page.title: Staff notifications
page.subtitle: Send staff emails and text messages from templates
page.discardContent: This template has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you switch tabs.

templates.adminOnly: Only administrators can edit templates. You can view the current wording.
templates.insertOnlyEmailBody: This variable is a whole block and can only go in the email body.
templates.emailBodyPlaceholder: Email body, English only. Use the variables above for the name, download buttons, etc.
templates.smsBodyPlaceholder: SMS text, English letters and common punctuation only. Leave empty to send no SMS.
templates.smsInfo: Over 160 characters is split into several billed messages. Chinese text, curly quotes or emoji cannot be saved.
templates.resetConfirmContent: The current subject, body and SMS text will be replaced by the default version. The name and enabled state stay as they are.
templates.resetFailed: Failed to restore the default wording
templates.switchDiscardContent: This template has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you switch.

duplicate.fail: A template with this name already exists. Please use another name

loginBox.pass: Contains {{variable}} (required for this template; it cannot be saved without it)
loginBox.fail: {{variable}} is missing. This template issues a random password and must include it in the email body, otherwise the staff member never receives the password, so it cannot be saved

loginBoxNotIssued.warn: General notice templates do not issue passwords, so {{variable}} has no effect. Consider removing it

download.warn: No download entry. You can add {{buttons}} or {{link}} (saving without it is allowed)

english.fail: Emails must be in English. No Chinese or full-width punctuation in the subject or body

variables.fail: Unknown variable(s): {{variables}}. Only the variables listed above can be used

length.fail: Email too long: subject {{subject}} / {{subjectMax}}, body {{body}} / {{bodyMax}} characters

length.empty: No SMS text: this template will not send an SMS
length.fail: About {{length}} characters, billed as {{segments}} messages. The limit is 3 messages ({{maxLength}} characters)

mailOnlyVariables.pass: No password in the SMS ({{variable}} cannot go in an SMS)
mailOnlyVariables.fail: {{variables}} cannot go in an SMS. They are email-only

charset.pass: English letters and common punctuation only
charset.fail: Unsupported SMS character(s): {{chars}}. Chinese text, curly quotes and emoji turn one SMS into 70 characters and double the cost

variables.fail: Unknown variable(s): {{variables}}. An SMS can only use {{allowed}}

logs.smsCostHint: Only messages actually sent are counted
logs.retryConfirmTitle: Retry the failed items of this batch?
logs.retryConfirmContent: Only the failed channels are resent: failed emails are resent; if only the SMS failed, only the SMS is sent again. No new password is generated.
logs.retryStarted: Retry started. This row will update with the result
logs.pollGiveUp: Cannot read the retry progress right now. Sending continues in the background, so press Refresh later to check
logs.loadFailed: Failed to load the send log
logs.empty: No send records match the filters
logs.detailLoadFailed: Failed to load the per-person details
logs.detailEmpty: This batch has no per-person details
